term: ideal semantic acceptance of a planning sentence
definition: Accepts state sentence means state ⊆ support sentence, with state a Set of descriptive/plan Points. It models elimination of incompatible options. It is ideal semantic acceptance, not an empirical claim that agents are explicitly aware of every consequence. Empty states accept all sentences; the controls exhibit nonempty states.
note: Analyst reconstruction for #185, motivated by the already pinned secondary account SEP-MORAL-COGNITIVISM §2.5. Exact conditional clauses and the psychological adequacy of compatible-state acceptance remain separate historical/fidelity obligations; see docs/expressivist-embedding-boundary.md. This models a possible planning language without asserting it is ordinary moral language.
